caveats: 10k pilots are not trained precision runs and cannot establish persistent discrepancies.
N^-1/2 sample and cost projections are conditional; allow at least a factor-two workload contingency.
Measured efficiency is summed worker elapsed time divided by allocated worker walltime, not OS CPU utilization.
Reference tolerance changes are empirical controls, not rigorous quadrature uncertainty bounds.
No absolute floor is used unless explicitly selected; relative precision is distinct from target agreement.
Per-component costs do not capture shared-run imbalance; paired T/L must run to the larger sample requirement.
